+title: 'SnapshotsGraph: changes(after:) subscription and cursor query (MT-13)'
+---
+## What
+**Blocked outside this repo:** HOOKS-1 (change stream of `SnapshotStore`, FoundationModelsHooks, status agreed, not built) and EXTRAS-10 (`ChangeLog` + `RESYNC_REQUIRED` in the Extras toolkit, status proposed). Neither has an owning session yet. Do not start until both have landed on `main` and `swift package update` picks them up.
+
+Following EXTRAS-9 rule 9 (TestudoApp `features/packages/foundationmodels-extras.md`, D115):
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Snapshots/SnapshotsGraph.swift`: subscription `changes(after: Int, sessionId: ID): SnapshotChange!`, where `SnapshotChange { seq: Int!, at: DateTime!, sessionId: ID!, index: Int! }`. Index is the new checkpoint; the client re-queries `checkpoint`. Add the root query `cursor: Int!`.
+- Feed: one `ChangeLog<SnapshotChange>` per graph, filled from the HOOKS-1 store stream; `changes(after:)` with a too-old `seq` → `RESYNC_REQUIRED`.
+- Alias table: `snapshotChanges` → `changes` (the MT-13 name).
+- Viewer: an `external` viewer gets only the events of sessions it owns.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A `take` or rollback on the store gives one `SnapshotChange` with an increasing `seq`
+- [ ] `changes(after: cursor)` gives only the events after `cursor`; a too-old cursor gives `RESYNC_REQUIRED`
+- [ ] `snapshotChanges` works through the alias
+- [ ] An external viewer does not get events of sessions it does not own
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/SnapshotsGraphChangesTests.swift` against a real `SnapshotStore` in a temp dir
+- [ ] Update the SDL golden; conformance is empty with no rule-9 exception left
+- [ ] `swift test --filter Snapshots` passes
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #graphql #snapshots #blocked-external
\ No newline at end of file
